title: Product reveal
caption: The product-reveal recipe: a spotlit hero product on a soft glow with a floor shadow, a category badge top left and the name and promise below, for launching one offer.
prompt: Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 6-second 16:9 product reveal for Magnifito's Website Starter package in the product-reveal style. Use the laptop product shot in assets/website-starter.svg as the hero, a "Website package" badge, the logo in the corner, and the line "Five pages, built so you can edit them yourself", which is an illustrative claim in claims.json. Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, the logo green #8acf31 used sparingly, Geist from fonts/, and the logo in assets/magnifito-logo.svg. Render it with HyperFrames.
